coordination.controller: One coordinator claims dependency-ready tickets, assigns isolated branches, tracks cloud tasks, reviews PRs and dispatches successors.
coordination.claim: One active assignment per ticket; leases and task IDs survive coordinator restart.
coordination.integration: Only coordinator integrates after required tests and independent review.
coordination.completion: Stop only when QA-1 acceptance criteria are verified; stop on user request, usage cap or input blocker.
restrictions: No secrets or production databases in GitHub/cloud fixtures
No cloud worker VPS deployment credentials
Preserve API budgets and fail-closed gates
coordination.idle_policy: On worker completion or coordinator waiting point, reuse an idle worker for unclaimed dependency-ready work; keep doing coordinator work meanwhile. No busywork or duplicate claims.

tasks.title: Finish finalized snapshot capture and slot-bounded history integration
acceptance: Persist snapshot and cutoff before replay; resume after interruption without changing cutoff.
Keep original 18-RPC ceiling; reject incomplete account coverage.
Verify matching and mismatching replay fixtures and one bounded live run.

tasks.title: Implement evidence-backed pool/service classification
acceptance: Every non-unknown label has provenance, scope, expiry and exact address binding.
Never treat an ordinary system account or shared funder as proven private control.
Unknown or contradictory labels block ownership approval.

tasks.title: Quantify distribution exposure in current holdings
acceptance: Trace ordered transfers and split distributions with bounded traversal.
Exclude only validated service/pool accounts; report lower bounds and unresolved exposure separately.
Adversarial fixtures cover fanout, cycles, service hubs and missing paths.

tasks.title: Independent ownership integration review
acceptance: Attempt to bypass gates using stale, missing, forged or inconsistent evidence.
Show evidence provenance and gaps for every result.
Mark ownership milestone complete only after full replay and live integration verification.

tasks.title: Complete supported exact-size unsigned buy and exit validation
acceptance: Validate every instruction, recipient, amount and account effect for a narrow supported route.
Reject unknown fees/extensions and unverified exits.
No signer or transaction broadcasting.

tasks.title: Build trusted live strategy input adapter
acceptance: Derive rather than assert input completeness and freshness.
Use deterministic Python strategy and sizing; preserve hard safety gates.
Do not manufacture missing flow/momentum/cost data.

tasks.title: Connect durable automatic paper entry and exit
acceptance: One accepted candidate produces a durable paper entry and verified exit.
Include costs and partial positions; replay is idempotent.
Outages and restarts cannot fabricate fills or conceal unsellable positions.

tasks.title: Finish paper dashboard and operating controls
acceptance: Display evidence reasons, positions, costs, net PnL and stale status.
Verify pause, exit-only and restart behavior.
Keep private loopback access.

tasks.title: Run end-to-end forward paper readiness gate
acceptance: Verify discovery through evidence, decision, entry, monitoring, exit, accounting and dashboard.
Exercise provider failures, restart and backup restore.
Report real-data observation duration and limitations; tests alone cannot establish readiness.
